# Loyalty, referral and shop page brief — R13
Baseline 09be5c7, development branch only. Current reference 2026-11-06-06; read current master/matrix/unresolved/map and latest owner task. No original company archive or newer approved commercial files found in repository. Original source coverage incomplete.

Routes/audiences: /loyalty-program/ qualifying repeat suit customers; /referral-program/ customers and non-customer applicants; /shop/ merchandise shoppers; /shop/{slug}/ published products; /shop/cart/ purchase-request checkout. C38/C39/C40/C43 plus direct R13 owner instructions support these pages. Loyalty no automatic extension beyond qualifying suits/no stacking. Referral completion/full-payment/handover prerequisites and one referrer/no-self/before-deposit supplied by latest owner; exact original operating terms and seven-day payout verification missing. Do not promise payout deadline. Applicants request human review, no auto approval/codes/commission issuance.

Shop uses separate Git catalogue; suit inspiration is not merchandise. Empty live catalogue until approved product data and images/rights/prices/variation stock supplied. Exactly Available in Stock / Available on Orders / Out of Stock. Price only for approved stock products; no fixed on-order price. Purchase requests do not reserve stock or confirm orders/payment. No shipping fees/coverage/returns promises invented. Manual delivery/payment instructions require review; existing general Terms/Privacy linked, no new shop-specific contractual claims. Bank/MobileMoney preferences; cryptocurrency disabled pending approval.

Forms: referral uses existing free Web3Forms endpoint/key extracted at build, unchanged recipient/provider. Shop uses Pages Function validating against generated approved catalogue then same Web3Forms integration; no private storage enabled or success before positive provider acceptance. Required name/phone, optional email, unchecked terms/privacy, honeypot, duplicate/error/retry controls, review. Client cart stores only product/variation IDs and quantities, no customer/payment details. Prices/stock revalidated server-side, no reservation. Provider inbox receipt and live Function deployment require external verification.

Button contracts: homepage programme links open respective pages; shared Shop opens /shop/. Category/search/sort filter catalogue. Published product cards open permanent detail route; in-stock Add to Cart validates variation/quantity; on-order Request Quote opens same-page accessible form; out-of-stock action disabled. Cart edit/remove persists anonymous IDs/quantity; review followed by submit sends server-validated request; failures preserve form/cart. Programme collection links /mensuits/, /womensuits/; loyalty eligibility enquiry /booking/; referral participation form stays on page. No unrelated redirects, payments, uploads or automatic WhatsApp.

SEO: unique titles/descriptions/H1/canonical/OG/Twitter, truthful Product data for published verified entries only; new content pages/public products eligible sitemap; cart/forms noindex; all staging remains noindex. No keyword/ranking claims.

Homepage impact limited to programme links and Shop label. Preserve galleries/support/Terms/booking/SEO. Tests planned: schema/bad catalogues, stock/variation/price tampering, mocked email positive/negative, cart persistence/stale inventory, keyboard/dialog/forms, mobile/desktop/Axe, existing homepage and booking regressions. Original operating terms, genuine product assets, shop-specific customer terms/fulfilment and crypto remain unresolved; owner review required before production.
